patch.value: Delegate memory credential detection to SDK mutation secret scanner
Implements companion pm-cli-website-d8bz G7. Delegate shared credential grammars to scanMutationSecrets, preserving explicit email consent and narrowly documented stronger memory rules.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Companion pm-cli-website-d8bz is read-only specification. Compare every existing credential rule against the public scanner before removal; retain local email, retention and identity/path policies, with real no-git tracker refusal and allowance tests.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Shared provider credential rules now use scanMutationSecrets. Supplements cover low-entropy and alias assignments, 16-character legacy keys, authorization headers, URL passwords, unbounded JWTs and mixed-case/long private-key markers. Four bounded decoding passes cover encoded/normalized credentials. SDK private-host matching is quadratic on hyphenated noncredentials, so shared scans use overlapping bounded windows with repeated-window reuse; domain path/identity rules retain their scope. See docs/sdk-adoption.md.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Validation: shared SDK scanner/decoding behavioral revert failed all 9 provider/encoded cases; the stronger-supplement corpus separately fails on revert because SDK-only provider credentials would enter memory. Restoration passed 15/15 adoption tests and the supplemental case. Linked scanner tests passed 9/9 with pm test --run --progress; adversarial privacy deadline controls passed 4/4. Production dependency audit found zero vulnerabilities. README, architecture and docs/sdk-adoption.md document the SDK floor, preserved local policies and scanner bounds. Full unchanged coverage/release gates remain CI work.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Post-PR adversarial inspection found a concrete encoded-credential bypass: a malformed UTF-8 suffix caused decodeURIComponent to retain the entire percent run, concealing an otherwise valid credential prefix. Replace invalid bytes in the inspection view instead, preserving valid decoded bytes. Add a real-tracker non-echoing regression and isolated before/fixed proof before the next review push.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Follow-up verification: malformed-percent UTF-8 regression fails against the prior decoder (1 failure) and passes after replacement decoding. Reverting only the scan-window boundary prefix also fails the safe embedded-identifier control (1 failure). Both proofs ran in the disposable worktree; restoration passed all 16 current adoption tests. Focused malformed/boundary controls passed 3/3, adversarial deadlines 4/4, and linked scanner runs passed 10/10 plus the supplemental corpus. Typecheck, lint, duplication and docstrings pass. This follow-up accompanies the code before the next review push.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Legacy policy comparison found SDK semantic differences for generic sk prefixes: short Anthropic-style keys fall between provider-specific floors, and the host word-end boundary differs from the older prefix refusal. Preserve the generic legacy prefix supplement after shared scanning, document the reason, and prove the missing cases on a real temporary tracker before batching with review findings.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Review round 1: fixed PR 51 thread PRRT_kwDOVPw2oc60erz8. Long quoted SSH/password values now receive complete quote-span SDK inspection with bounded bodies, normalized prefix whitespace, both quote styles and mixed delimiters; the existing identity exclusions remain unchanged. No SSH/password credential grammar was copied. Reverting sharedCredential alone fails the real-tracker quoted regression (1 failure). Separate legacy-prefix and JWT-union reverts each fail the real-tracker compatibility case (1 each). Restored adoption tests passed 18/18; the linked pm runner also passed all 18 current tests. Adversarial deadline controls passed 4/4 after a necessary at-sign precheck preserved email semantics and avoided needless email backtracking. Lint, typecheck, duplication (0%), docstrings and build pass. The attached exec alert is RegExp.exec, with no process execution API imported.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Final wrapper check found that JSON serialization doubles the backslashes in an already escaped credential, leaving separator backslashes in the inspection view. Normalize repeated escape introducers without adding provider grammars; add a real-tracker JSON-wrapped escape regression and a disposable before/fixed proof before the queued second review.

value.text: Serialized escape wrappers verified: restoring the prior credentialViews decoder fails the JSON-wrapped real-tracker regression (1 failure). Lint, typecheck, duplication (0%) and docstrings pass. The second bot review is still queued and will receive this corrected head.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Review round 2 requests a distinct quoted-span adversarial deadline case. Measure the real SDK path first; retain full quoted credential detection and optimize only if the fixed deadline exposes repeated scan cost. Companion pm-cli-website-d8bz remains read only.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Review round 2 fixed: quote-prefix contexts restart at delimiters, and short contiguous spans already covered by raw windows skip redundant SDK calls. Long spans and normalized whitespace still receive complete shared inspection. Added 25000 distinct quoted spans to the unchanged 500ms/process deadline controls; expanded the real-tracker quoted corpus with short credentials behind long whitespace. Final linked adoption run passes 19/19, expanded quoted test 1/1, and linked deadline/JWT run 6/6. Earlier wall-time failures under CPU contention included unchanged controls; the final run passes without threshold changes. Reverting only quotedCredentialViews in a disposable worktree fails the new process-deadline test; restored implementation passes the six-case controls. Lint, typecheck, duplication 0 percent and docstring gates pass. Companion pm-cli-website-d8bz remains read only. Push this fix for review round 3 and final-head full CI.

value.text: Review round 4 on the preceding head reports adjacent literal suffix masking, long whitespace projection, and missing long distinct-quote deadline controls. value.author: codex-sol

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round-4 evidence: restoring the old privacy masking fails the adjacent-literal regression; disabling the whitespace projection fails the unquoted-assignment regression. Restoring fixed functions passes 2/2. Linked new regressions pass 2/2, existing shared quoted SDK control 1/1, and issue-52 regressions still pass 6/6. value.author: codex-sol

Removing that unreachable fallback; the other missing branch belongs to G1 ownership-field validation.

value.author: codex-sol

Both completed prior CI legs pass 720/720 and core.ts is 100/100/100/100. The export description fallback was unreachable because Memory.description and the public SDK read model require a string; it is removed without changing policy. The focused ownership/baseline/legacy-export probe passes 3/3. Fresh final-head CI must certify the complete gate after this coverage repair.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round 5 confirms a nested-object credential gap. Fixing inherited credential-key context and adding genuine-SDK refusal/reference controls. The public SecretGuardFinding.rule type exposes a literal inventory: use an exhaustive policy map checked against that public union, with unknown runtime findings conservatively refused, rather than freezing the peer range or importing private rules. Keep the explicit user-required 500ms deadline; both Node 26 full gates pass every deadline and 100/100/100/100 coverage.

value.author: codex-sol
value.text: Round-5 linked secret controls pass 2/2. Reverting inherited parent context fails the nested-object case; changing the known identity exclusion fails its accepted control. Omitting npm_token from the exhaustive policy fails typecheck against the public SecretGuardFinding.rule union. Restoring source passes 5/5 joint cases and typecheck. No SDK mocks/private inventory imports are used. The fixed 500ms and process deadlines remain unchanged as required; both completed prior full Node 26 gates pass all deadline cases, 720/720 tests and 100/100/100/100 coverage. The fifth review round is complete; valid findings are fixed and refusals will be answered after the push.
